evidence.finding: Official metrics from results-01.json (candidate / native): case1 fp16 MERE=1.5260e-3 / 1.5780e-3, MARE=47.09 / 116.90, max_abs=3.70059e-4 (identical candidate and native); case2 fp16 MERE=1.6305e-3 / 1.6067e-3, max_abs=9.17e-5 / 1.023e-4; case4 bf16 MERE=1.3736e-2 / 1.3927e-2, max_abs=7.0390e-4 / 6.9005e-4; case7 bf16 MERE=1.3505e-2 / 1.3183e-2, max_abs=6.1245e-4 / 6.2911e-4. Every case has official_formula_pass=false for both candidate and native; supplementary_allclose=true does not count. The candidate/native max_abs agreement (3.700592284897608e-4 for case1 on both sides) indicates a shared precision ceiling rather than a candidate-specific logic bug.

MERE/threshold ratios: case1 fp16 1.5625 (thr=2^-10=9.765625e-4), case4 bf16 1.7582 (thr=2^-7=7.8125e-3). Measured max_abs expressed in input unit roundoff: case1 3.70059e-4 / 2^-11 = 0.758 ulp_fp16; case4 7.0390e-4 / 2^-8 = 0.180 ulp_bf16. These absolute errors are far above an fp32 accumulate floor and far above the output-rounding floor for y~O(0.03) (0.03*2^-11/2 ~ 7.3e-6 fp16, 0.03*2^-8/2 ~ 5.9e-5 bf16). This is consistent with cancellation error injected by rounding softmax probabilities before PV, which grows relative to small |golden|.

Line 90 computes acc = acc * alpha[:, None] + tl.dot(p.to(v.dtype), v). p is the fp32 online-softmax probability but is rounded to v.dtype (fp16 or bf16) before the PV tensor-core dot. For a cancellation output y=sum_j p_j v_j / l, this injects an absolute error ~u*sum_j p_j|v_j|/l with u=2^-11 (fp16) or 2^-8 (bf16); at outputs near zero it produces the huge MARE. QK (line 74) consumes the exact fp16/bf16 q,k with fp32 accumulation, and the softmax max/sum/rescale are already fp32, so PV probability rounding is the sole high-impact precision loss.

Section 4 fixes official thresholds (fp16 2^-10, bf16 2^-7) and defines MERE/MARE with denominator |golden|+1e-7; section 3 fixes output dtype to the input dtype (fp16/bf16), so final output rounding is irreducible. Candidate must not relax thresholds or alter golden.

hypothesis: The dominant numerical error is the pre-PV downcast of the fp32 softmax probabilities to fp16/bf16. It is an absolute error proportional to the probability-weighted magnitude of V and therefore blows up as a relative error for near-zero outputs. QK and softmax are already effectively fp32-accurate, so a probability representation that retains fp32-level precision through PV should collapse max_abs toward the output-rounding / fp32-accumulation floor and bring MERE under the official thresholds.
change: Precision-first PV using a residual-split probability: compute p_hi = fp16/bf16(p), r = p - fp32(p_hi) exactly in fp32, p_lo = fp16/bf16(r * 2048) to keep residuals normal, then acc = acc*alpha + tl.dot(p_hi, v) + tl.dot(p_lo, v)/2048. Both dots use the already-supported fp16/bf16 inputs with fp32 accumulation; QK and the fp32 online softmax are unchanged. The 2048 scale avoids fp16 subnormal flush of the residual term. This retains ~2^-22 (fp16) / ~2^-16 (bf16) relative probability precision, i.e. fp32-level through PV, at the cost of a second PV dot (performance second).
expected: max_abs should fall from measured 9.2e-5..7.0e-4 to the output-rounding/fp32-accumulation floor (~1e-5 fp16, ~1e-4 bf16 for y~O(0.03)); MERE should drop below 2^-10 (fp16) and 2^-7 (bf16). MARE is expected to improve by orders of magnitude (currently 47-1189) but may remain limited by true golden values within ~1e-7 of zero, which no fp16/bf16 output can resolve; this is recorded as an open unknown, not assumed fixed.
validation: External fixed benchmark attention_bench.py on the official case subset will recompute MERE/MARE/max_abs for this source; no preflight/benchmark is run in this call and no thresholds/golden change. Success criterion for the mechanism: candidate max_abs and MERE drop close to the stated output-rounding floor and MERE passes both dtype thresholds; MARE and native failure are reported honestly.
alternatives: QK fp16 tensor-core accumulation is low precision. Argued against: q,k are exact input fp16 values, products are exact in fp32 and tl.dot accumulates fp32; measured candidate error matches the P-downcast scale and native has the same max_abs.

The failure is solely the final fp16/bf16 output rounding. Argued against: output-rounding floor is ~7e-6 (fp16) / ~6e-5 (bf16) at y~0.03, 5-50x below measured max_abs; and it would not scale with the P precision as observed.
discriminating_observation: Case1 native and candidate share the same max_abs=3.700592284897608e-4 while both round softmax probabilities to fp16 before PV; the value is ~0.76 ulp_fp16 and far above the output-rounding floor. Removing only the probability downcast should reduce max_abs by ~1-2 orders of magnitude while leaving QK/softmax untouched.
